_comment: Every product that has appeared in any Breakpoint MCP competitive-analysis sweep,
carried forward permanently.  An entry is never dropped: products that stop moving
are marked `dormant` or `archive` and keep their ruling, so a later sweep does not
re-litigate a question already answered.
`assetlib_version` / `assetlib_modify_date` are what the live Asset Library API
served when this entry was last reconciled; scripts/assetlib_sweep.py compares
the live API against them and reports anything that moved.
`last_analysed` is the date of the last SOURCE-LEVEL pass, which is a stronger
claim than a version check.  When a sweep reports an entry moved, it owes a
source-level pass; when it reports no change, `no change since <last_analysed>`
is a complete and sufficient result for that entry.
House terminology: these are ALTERNATIVE MCP SERVERS, not rivals.  See
docs/LANDSCAPE_TRACKING_POLICY.md.
🆕 291 — THIS ROSTER HAS TWO POPULATIONS, AND THE SPLIT IS THE POINT.
`entries` are products READ AT SOURCE, each with a ruling: debugger, real_dap_client,
real_lsp_client, csharp, protocol_revision and a note. The cost of a row here is a
source-level pass, so a row is ELECTED and never automatic.
`surfaced` are products a DISCOVERY LEG has seen, carried permanently, holding only
what the leg itself supplies: channel, repository slug, package, version, publish date
and the session that first saw them. No capability claim, because no one has read them.
The cost of a row here is one row, so EVERY project any leg surfaces owes one, and
`assetlib_sweep.py --check` refuses when one is missing.
🔴 WHY IT IS TWO AND NOT ONE. Until 291 the sweep had a single severity — a
never-tracked MCP-shaped entry owed a source-level pass — which was affordable while
the population was ONE channel serving roughly ten new entries a year. The first run
across three channels surfaced fifty. A rule demanding fifty source-level passes in one
commit does not produce fifty analyses; it produces a gate that is red forever and a
roster nobody can make green. Fifty rows with the capability fields blank would be
worse still: that is a coverage claim nobody made.
`channel` records where a product SHIPS, and it is optional. Forty-five entries predate
the channel legs and nobody has recorded where any of them ships; `assetlib_sweep.py
--census` prints that count as `unclassified` rather than defaulting it, so the number
is a visible intake that falls as sessions classify rows.

entries.name: beckett-godot-mcp
entries.note: SOURCE PASS 284 — card said no change, head moved fbd9b3d -> 947ee6b, and the source moved substantially: three commits, 23 files, +1863/-93, and the addon is at 1.14.0 while the card still reads 1.12.1. 🔴 ROSTER CORRECTION: csharp was recorded false and is TRUE — tools/csharp_tools.gd:28 registers build_csharp and :62 shells out to dotnet build, parsing CS-coded diagnostics. It has been there since v1.5.0 and was already present at the previously recorded commit, so the roster value was wrong BEFORE this window rather than newly changed. The v1.14 theme is context cost: a `help` tool serves long-form argument catalogues on demand and is deliberately excluded from tools/list, and descriptions were trimmed to capability statements. A new capture:// resource store parks screenshots under user:// and returns an MCP resource_link instead of megabytes of base64, degrading link -> both for peers below protocol revision 2025-06-18. 55 tools by two agreeing derivations (registry.register literals; and the generated glama/tools.json), corroborated by ci-smoke.ps1 -ExpectedTools 55; the delta from 54 is exactly `help`. No DAP and no LSP — zero hits for either. Zero-sidecar transport: hand-rolled HTTP/1.1 + SSE on a Godot TCPServer inside the editor process. This repo is the MIT Lite edition — core/effort.gd enumerates 91 tool names across six cumulative tiers and 55 register here. 🔵 **AND THE CARD CAUGHT UP THE SAME DAY.** Hours after this pass the Asset Library listing moved 1.12.1 -> 1.14.0 (2026-08-26), which is the version already read here at `947ee6b`. Recorded rather than re-passed: the source was analysed at 284 and has not moved since, so what changed is the card catching up to it, not the product.

entries.name: Godot-MCP (IvanMurzak)
entries.note: SOURCE PASS 284. bd1b8e4..b91650c is two commits, 24 files, +842/-39, and it is auth and UX only — no tool and no transport change. A 'D4 assisted ladder' (GodotAssistedSignIn.cs) auto-opens the browser at the device-auth verification URL once per editor session; GodotAccountAuth.cs re-hooks SignInRequired/AuthStateChanged across provider swaps; and a silent-failure fix in ConnectionPanelView.cs, where a dead machine-store credential previously rendered nothing for a signed-in user. 42 tools by two agreeing derivations ([AiTool] attributes; and the first positional argument of every [AiTool(] block with ToolId constants resolved) — of which 39 are advertised to MCP clients, the other three being System tools routed to a disjoint registry reachable only over HTTP /api/system-tools/. DEBUGGER STILL 'none', with a nuance worth recording: there IS structured runtime-error capture via the Godot 4.5+ OS.AddLogger hook plus AppDomain.UnhandledException, surfacing multi-frame ScriptBacktrace data through runtime-errors-get — richer than log scraping, but passive post-hoc diagnostics with no execution control, so not a debugger. No DAP and no LSP: zero repo-wide hits for Content-Length, setBreakpoints, :6005 or textDocument. C# is real and total — the addon IS C# and needs the .NET Godot build — but script-validate is GDScript-only by its own comment, since there is no in-editor C# compiler to reach cheaply. Cloud-first: the addon is a SignalR client dialling a hosted backend at ai-game.dev or a self-hosted URL. Effectively single-maintainer, 220 of 221 commits.

entries.name: godot-agent-loop
entries.note: SOURCE PASS 284 — card said no change, head moved 2c6127b -> 3148cda, and this window is real behaviour: 13 commits, 26 files, +896/-71, with ~490 lines of new tests and no version bump (3.0.0 both ends). 🔴 ROSTER CORRECTION: csharp was recorded false and is TRUE — verify_dotnet_project (inspect|restore|build|run) probes dotnet --version and runs restore/build against a versioned Godot.NET.Sdk. Unchanged in this window, so the roster value was already wrong at the previously recorded commit. The substantive change is child-environment sanitization: every spawned Godot process now gets a 22-key allowlist rather than inheriting process.env, on the stated reasoning that project GDScript runs with the user's OS permissions and can therefore read any inherited credential. Short-lived CLI runs additionally get GODOT_MCP_RUNTIME_DISABLED=true so validate/test/import/export never open a runtime listener. Startup failures now surface instead of hanging — a GameStartupError carrying exitCode/signal, thrown when the process exits during the connect delay. 56 tools by three agreeing routes (rawToolDefinitions; the toolManifest record keys; the handler dispatch keys), unchanged across the window. Only 16 core tools are advertised by default, the other 40 reached through godot_catalog progressive disclosure, against a pinned context budget. No DAP, and LSP is explicitly scoped OUT in docs/coverage/engine-scope.json: diagnostics come from validate_script via --check-only rather than from driving the language server. Node stdio sidecar plus an authenticated loopback TCP channel to an injected in-game interaction server. Card is at 1.0.0 against a source 3.0.0.

entries.name: Wick
entries.assetlib_title: Wick — C# MCP Server for Godot
entries.note: SOURCE PASS 284, and this entry is why Rule 2 has a second clause: the Asset Library card has not moved since 2026-04-26 and the head moved 99806df -> 5540357. Reading it: FIVE commits, all 2026-08-13, 3 files, +10/-10 — Dependabot bumps (MessagePack, Roslyn, Microsoft.Extensions.*) and one CI action. No src/, tests/ or addons/ file touched; the tool surface, DAP, LSP and C# paths are byte-identical. 'Nothing that matters changed' is the finding, and it is a MEASURED one. 64 tools by two agreeing derivations ([McpServerTool] attributes across 12 [McpServerToolType] classes; and the declarative catalog in DefaultToolGroups.cs) — agreement is CI-enforced by DefaultToolGroupsTests.cs, not coincidence. Only 17 are advertised out of the box: tools are gated into five opt-in pillars via WICK_GROUPS, defaulting to core. Still the only tracked entry with BOTH a real DAP client and a real LSP client, and both are confirmed at source: GodotDapClient.cs opens a raw TcpClient to 127.0.0.1:6006 with hand-rolled Content-Length framing and an adapterID=godot initialize handshake; GodotLspClient.cs speaks LSP to 127.0.0.1:6005 and a second CSharpLspClient.cs spawns csharp-ls over stdio. SCOPE CAVEAT WORTH CARRYING: the DAP verbs are launch, configurationDone, stackTrace, evaluate and variables — there is no setBreakpoints and no continue/step, so it is a real DAP client with launch-and-inspect verbs rather than debug-session control. C# is the centre of gravity, not a bolt-on: MSBuildWorkspace, GetSemanticModel, SymbolFinder, with tests. VERSION DIVERGENCE: source has been 1.0.0 since tag v1.0.0 while the card still reads 0.1.0 — one major version and four months behind, which is the sharpest evidence in this roster that an Asset Library version is not a usable freshness signal. Cadence: last substantive source commit 2026-04-30; everything since is Dependabot or CI. Maintained rather than developed.

entries.name: godot-mcp (tomyud)
entries.note: SOURCE PASS 284. Resumed after a 125-day gap: one squashed release commit (3037a5b, 2026-08-24, +5369/-316) took it 0.5.0 -> 0.6.0, so the 'dormant' ruling recorded at 2026-08-10 no longer holds. The new work is transactional editing — a disk-backed snapshot store (snapshot_store.gd, undo_manager.gd) with a _MUTATING_TOOLS registry that auto-snapshots every mutating tool, plus batch_execute with atomic rollback as one undo entry. Deliberately NOT wired to EditorUndoRedoManager, so the editor's own Ctrl+Z does not reach AI edits. 75 tools registered by two independent derivations (allTools in mcp-server/src/tools/index.ts, executed; and the GDScript _tool_map union in tool_executor.gd), 77 advertised on the wire (index.ts:279 prepends get_godot_status and get_guide). Its own READMEs disagree with each other (75, 42 and 32) — counts here are from source. Debugger state is read by walking EditorInterface.get_base_control() for a ScriptEditorDebugger node and scraping its error Tree widget, so no DAP and no LSP. GDScript only: create_script hard-rejects non-.gd. Node stdio server hosting a WebSocket on 127.0.0.1:6505 that the editor addon and an in-game autoload both dial into.

entries.name: godot-mcp (DaxianLee)
entries.note: BASELINED AT 284 — this entry had NO last_analysed_commit, so the sweep's Rule 2 second clause was blind to it and reported SRC ?. Head is 1b03129 (2026-01-14); source version 1.0.0 matches the card. 🔴 STATUS CORRECTION active -> dormant: the ENTIRE history is three commits, 2026-01-04 to 2026-01-14, and nothing in six months. Category confirmed — mcp_server.gd:122 listens on TCP and :443 handles tools/list. 74 tools, derived from the 22 executors registered at mcp_server.gd:200-231 against the flattened _tool_definitions. No DAP, no LSP, no C# (zero .cs in tree).

entries.name: Ziva
entries.note: BASELINED AT 284, and the baselining overturned the classification. 🔴 THE TRACKED REPO IS AN INSTALLER SHELL, NOT AN MCP SERVER. ziva-via-godot-asset-library-installer contains a C++ GDExtension whose only network call fetches the latest release of ziva-sh/ziva-agent-plugin-godot (installer_download.gd:35); there are zero MCP or JSON-RPC references anywhere in it. The agent repo it installs was also read at 284 (head fae411b, 2026-02-15) and holds only README, assets and llms.txt — the agent ships as release BINARIES, so there is no source to take a pass over, and its own README says code is sent to Ziva's servers for processing. `alternative-mcp-server` is therefore UNVERIFIABLE from source rather than confirmed, and this note records that rather than a category change, because Rule 2's remedy for an unreadable entry is evidence and not a guess. Status active -> dormant: 35 commits 2026-03-08 to 2026-06-15, nothing since. Head 65fab39, source 0.2.5, matching the card.

entries.name: coding-solo-godot-mcp
entries.note: 🔴 THE ENTRY THIS ROSTER'S POPULATION WAS BLIND TO, AND THE MOST-STARRED PROJECT IN THE CATEGORY. 5,399 stars at the 2026-08-27 reading against hi-godot/godot-ai's 1,954, which this roster and two published analyses both called the clear popularity leader; that claim was wrong for as long as it was made and no health in the Asset Library leg could have said so. Ships on npm only — verified by grepping every .md/.json/.gd/.ts/.yml in the repository for Asset Library install instructions, zero hits. 14 tools, MIT, last commit 2026-04-16. It is the UPSTREAM of tugcantopaloglu/godot-mcp, which this roster has tracked since it had 439 stars. 🟢 Credit where it is due (Rule 4): it has a visible security posture — external hardening pull requests for shell injection and arbitrary GDScript instantiation were merged promptly. `last_analysed_commit` is deliberately null: the 2026-08-27 pass recorded capabilities, not a SHA, and 284's rule is that a baseline nobody read is worse than an honest `unread`.

entries.name: satelliteoflove-godot-mcp
entries.note: 🟢 THE MOST ACTIVE PROJECT IN THE CATEGORY AND THE ONE WITH THE BROADEST CI, AND SAYING SO IS RULE 4 WORKING. 21 tools / 88 actions, MIT, 309 commits with a release cut on the day it was read. MCP revision 2025-06-18, SDK 1.30.0. Roughly 458 TypeScript tests, 24 GDScript headless tests and 8 agent evals across 4 CI workflows, including a wire-level protocol smoke test against the BUILT artifact and tool-schema snapshot tests — a shape worth learning from. Deterministic game-time control: `freeze` / `step` / `step_until` / `thaw`. It is the first project found on all three enumerable channels at once (npm, the official MCP Registry, GitHub Releases), which is what makes it the fold's own positive control.

entries.name: ryanmazzolini-minimal-godot-mcp
entries.note: 🟢 A FOURTH REAL DAP CLIENT, AND IT MOVED NOTHING — WHICH IS RULE 4's DEPTH RULE DEMONSTRATED RATHER THAN ARGUED. It opens a socket to port 6006 and speaks the Debug Adapter Protocol, and to port 6005/6007 for LSP, so `real_dap_client` and `real_lsp_client` are both true. Measured at source: it sends exactly TWO DAP requests — `initialize` and `attach` — and uses the connection as a pipe for `output` events. Its four tools are `get_diagnostics`, `scan_workspace_diagnostics`, `get_console_output`, `clear_console_output`. No breakpoints, no stepping, no stack trace, no scopes, no variables, no C#. So the category now has four projects with a real DAP client and the number that can step through a breakpoint is unchanged: an existence claim would have decayed here for the fourth time; the depth claim did not move at all.

entries.name: bradypp-godot-mcp
entries.note: 16 tools, a clean decomposition of Coding-Solo's monolith with a genuine read-only mode. Dormant since 2025-05-31. 🔴 `channel` IS NULL AND THAT IS THE MEASUREMENT: it ships by `git clone` alone — no addon, no package, no registry entry — so no enumerable channel can surface it and no leg in this file will ever re-read it. It is here because a human named it, which is the same standing as the `commercial` rows and is why `channel: null` prints as `unclassified` rather than being defaulted into a channel that never saw it.

entries.name: gdai-mcp-plugin-godot
entries.note: Closed-source commercial product, sold from gdaimcp.com. The GitHub repository is a shopfront and a version-check endpoint — 11 files, and `main.gd` is one line; "All rights reserved", no LICENSE. 🔴 `source_verifiable: false` IS THE POINT OF THE ROW. Every capability field is `null` and not `false`: this roster's other rows carry rulings taken by reading source, and writing `false` here would be a ruling nobody is able to take. A later sweep that finds these nulls should leave them alone rather than treat them as a gap to close — the gap is the licence, not the analysis.

entries.name: summer-engine
entries.note: An AI-native desktop game engine with a HOSTED MCP server — free tier plus paid plans. Engine-level rather than file-level: it runs the scene, reads live runtime errors and generates assets. 🔵 CATEGORISED `adjacent-hosted-product` RATHER THAN `alternative-mcp-server` BECAUSE IT IS NOT AN ALTERNATIVE TO BREAKPOINT — a user choosing it is choosing a different engine, not a different MCP server for Godot. It is on the roster because the tracking policy carries every product any sweep has seen and because a hosted engine-level MCP server is the shape of the category's next question, not because it competes for the same install. No repository: `source_verifiable: false` for the same reason as GDAI, one channel over.
